sets.name: Arabesque Opus
sets.concept: A gala-scale platinum and emerald suite that elevates the arabesque into illuminated architecture for evening gowns, headlined by a bold necklace priced above 100,000 dirhams.
sets.story: The design speaks in grand scrolls and palmette leaves that command the neckline. Platinum carries a crisp white glow while emeralds pour vivid green light through calibrated channels. Negative space is choreographed to feel airy despite the bold footprint. The hero necklace is built for the ballroom and priced above 100,000 dirhams.
sets.metal: 950 platinum in luminous cool white with selective black rhodium shading inside deep recesses
sets.surface: Hand mirror polish on crests, fine line engraving and milgrain on borders, frost satin in inner scrolls for tonal depth
sets.stones: Vivid emeralds in sugarloaf cabochon center, calibre baguettes, pear and marquise accents, with high colorless diamonds in micro pave and tapered baguette channels; discreet onyx knife-edge inlays to sharpen contours
sets.silhouette: Architectural collar with a central palmette drop for the necklace, chandelier earrings that taper from double scrolls, an articulated bracelet of interlocking arabesque links, a sculpted dome ring with split shoulders, and a pendant echo of the central drop
sets.motif: Double-scroll arabesque with palmette and split leaf transitions
sets.rhythm: Strict bilateral symmetry along a central axis with nested repeats that scale from small to grand using a one to 1.618 progression, perimeter milgrain as a steady visual metronome
sets.structure: A platinum exoskeleton carries a filigree lattice with laser welded bridges, calibre emeralds set in continuous channels, center stone in sculpted bezel with under gallery for light, micro pave executed with four claw micro prongs and raised protective rims
avoid: Oriental or exotic as descriptors
Arabian Nights cliches
Princess naming
Religious symbols or mosque silhouettes
Green enamel imitation of emerald
Overly thin filigree that snags fabrics
Mixed tone gold that fights the platinum clarity
Neon green or uneven gemstone color
design_dna: The arabesque slope must begin and end in a soft taper that meets a bead set diamond rim.
All emeralds are framed by a platinum lip of equal thickness to ensure chroma contrast.
Negative space within scrolls is preserved as light wells so the pieces breathe at large scale.
Pave density grades from center to edge in two steps for the necklace and one step for other items.
Clasps hide within a repeating motif and lock with a soft tactile click.
Earring backs are omega style for stability and comfort on formal evenings.
Rings use a triple split shoulder that resolves into the master scroll.
Pendant bails are integrated leaf loops sized for evening chains and crochet cords.

concept_art.form: Cathedral-like cascades of interlocking arabesques that bloom from a central palmette
concept_art.motion: Slow ceremonial rise from center to edge with a gentle inward return
concept_art.material: Liquid bright platinum ribbing against velvet satin recesses with glassy emerald light
concept_art.atmosphere: Majestic, cool, luminous and composed for grand evening presence

sets.name: Emerald Courtyard
sets.concept: A versatile platinum and emerald suite that distills the arabesque into crisp modular cells for ease of wear, led by a statement necklace above 100,000 dirhams.
sets.story: Courtyard geometry becomes intimate and wearable through a family of pointed ovoid tiles. The vocabulary is clean, gleaming and generous with emerald highlights. Modularity supports mix and match across occasions without losing the evening aura. The hero necklace remains a luxurious centerpiece above 100,000 dirhams.
sets.metal: 950 platinum with bright polish on frames and silk satin within recesses
sets.surface: Mirror edges with micro chamfer, soft satin cores, restrained milgrain only at outer perimeters
sets.stones: Oval and round emeralds in bezel and shared prong settings, diamond halos in micro pave, calibre baguette diamond frames on the hero element
sets.silhouette: Graduated medallion necklace with a detachable central pendant, medium drop earrings from a single tile, a flexible bracelet of repeating lozenges, a low profile ring that nests the master cell, and a pendant that can sit alone on a chain
sets.motif: Pointed ovoid leaf cell interlocked with a gentle ogee curve
sets.rhythm: Even tessellation along the strand with mirrored pairs around center, one to one spacing for a calm commercial cadence
sets.structure: Hinged connectors with hidden barrels for flow, convertible pendant bails that dock into the necklace, secure box clasp with twin safety for the bracelet
avoid: Overload of micro details that complicate daily wear
Overly literal oriental wording
Princess or bridal tropes
Mixing rose or yellow alloys with platinum in a single piece
Hanging lengths that tangle with hair or veils
Aggressive prong tips that catch delicate couture
Emerald beads of uneven color
design_dna: Every module repeats the same pointed ovoid ratio so sets match at a glance.
Borders are always mirror bright and interiors are satin to express depth without extra stones.
Emerald accents sit at the node of each interlock to mark rhythm.
Halos use the same micro pave grain size to keep brilliance consistent.
Ear pieces balance from omega backs or large friction discs to stabilize.
Rings remain under eight millimeters above the finger for comfort in social settings.
The detachable pendant must be wearable on both silk cords and fine chains with the same bail.

concept_art.form: Repeating courtyard cells with pointed ovoid windows
concept_art.motion: Measured pulse along a necklace line and quiet sway at the ears
concept_art.material: Bright platinum frames with satin cores and crystal green accents
concept_art.atmosphere: Refined, balanced, confident and travel ready for formal dinners

sets.name: Calligraphic Current
sets.concept: A kinetic platinum and emerald suite where the arabesque becomes a sweeping calligraphic current tailored for fluid movement with evening gowns, anchored by a hero necklace above 100,000 dirhams.
sets.story: Influenced by the gesture of ink across parchment, curves surge then soften into silence. Emeralds chase the motion as droplets and blades of green. Every articulation is tuned to sway rather than jangle. The collar commands attention while floating comfortably across the clavicle.
sets.metal: 950 platinum, spring-tempered ribs for controlled flexibility with polished crests and soft brushed flanks
sets.surface: Mirror crests, directional brushing along flow lines, subtle planishing under surfaces to break glare
sets.stones: Marquise and tapered baguette emeralds that line the strokes in graduating sizes, select emerald briolettes at terminal points, colorless diamond micro pave that fades out toward the edges
sets.silhouette: A swept collar that arcs across the neckline with a streaming tail, S curve earrings of moderate length, a flexible wrap bracelet that crosses once, a bypass ring that mirrors the master stroke, and a comma pendant suspended from a slim chain
sets.motif: Elongated S stroke with a palmette flick at the climax of the curve
sets.rhythm: Asymmetric equilibrium with stone size and density increasing toward the apex then dissolving to quiet
sets.structure: Segmented platinum spines joined by pivoting knuckles, micro coil springs hidden beneath diamond pave to control return, reinforced end caps protecting briolettes
avoid: Literal letters or scripts
Tassels that extend beyond five centimeters
Overuse of dangles that create noise during movement
Edges sharp enough to catch fine fabrics or hair
Overcrowded pave that robs the emeralds of focus
Heavy earrings without counterbalance
design_dna: Every curve begins tangentially and resolves into a soft zero angle so the pieces read as one gesture.
Emeralds sit slightly proud of the metal to catch light from above during motion.
Pave always grades from bright at the apex to sparse near the tail.
Visible metal edges are knife polished while hidden galleries are satin.
All moving joints are concealed under a diamond line so mechanics never distract.
Earrings are balanced by sculpted backs or small counterweights for graceful swing.
Bracelets flex in one plane only to avoid twisting on the wrist.
Rings feature a low inner arch for stability and a rounded inner comfort fit.

concept_art.form: Long sinuous strokes that swell then taper like a calligrapher’s flourish
concept_art.motion: Directional sweep with a decelerating glide at the finish
concept_art.material: Platinum ribbons with specular highlights and emerald droplets of light
concept_art.atmosphere: Fluid, poised, contemporary elegance tuned for motion

sets.name: Verdant Platinum
sets.concept: A tactile platinum and emerald suite that sculpts the arabesque into high relief planes and frosted valleys, conceived for opulent evening texture with a marquee necklace above 100,000 dirhams.
sets.story: Material speaks first in this suite. Frosted recesses and mirror spines create a quiet play of light that flatters skin tones under chandeliers. Emeralds arrive as bold masses carved and buff top to celebrate depth of color. The lead necklace crowns the set with museum scale presence.
sets.metal: 950 platinum with frosted valleys, mirror ridges, and micro hammered accents for soft sparkle
sets.surface: Directional satin blasting within curls, chisel lapped facets on outer edges, fine milgrain only where shadow needs to break, interiors sealed with high polish to brighten emerald transmission
sets.stones: Sugarloaf and high dome cabochon emeralds for center masses, buff top calibre emeralds for borders, carved leaf emerald accents, diamond baguettes and carre cuts to trace structure
sets.silhouette: A broad collar of sculpted plaques that read as one continuous relief, medium length ear drops that showcase a single emerald dome in a carved cradle, a broad articulated bracelet with soft edges, a domed signet style ring, and a pendant that isolates the master plaque
sets.motif: Relief arabesque leaf swirl with spine over valley morphology
sets.rhythm: Alternation of matte then gloss then stone mass in a repeating three beat cycle around the contour
sets.structure: Robust platinum rails that rise above frosted channels, protective bezels around cabochons, floating galleries under large stones to lighten weight and rinse light
avoid: High mirror finish everywhere that flattens relief
Overuse of micro pave that obscures the sculpted metal
Green enamel substitutes for carved emerald
Sharp inner corners that collect debris
Coatings that yellow the platinum tone
Too many motifs competing in one piece
design_dna: Relief height never exceeds the diameter of the adjacent cabochon for comfort and balance.
Cabochons are always bezel held with a small inner step for security.
Buff top calibres must meet at clean butt joints to form continuous rivers of green.
Alternating matte and gloss runs are kept in a predictable rhythm so pieces read cohesive.
Bracelet edges are softly bullnosed to feel like polished stone.
Rings taper under the finger and hide weight within open galleries.
Pendants keep a closed back polished mirror to amplify emerald glow.

concept_art.form: High relief leaves and scroll spines rising from frosted valleys
concept_art.motion: Slow undulation across broad planes that catch chandelier light
concept_art.material: Frosted platinum and mirror ridges meeting saturated emerald masses
concept_art.atmosphere: Textural, opulent, calm and confident under evening light

sets.name: Aerial Mashrabiya
sets.concept: A future forward platinum and emerald suite that engineers the arabesque as a vaulted mashrabiya lattice with emerald apertures, centered on a breathable collar priced above 100,000 dirhams.
sets.story: The design treats pattern as architecture. Cellular ribs rise and fall like a lightweight vault that hugs the body without bulk. Emeralds punctuate the cells as windows of saturated green. The bold collar delivers volume with air and carries the luxury intent.
sets.metal: 950 platinum with high polish on ribs and vapor blast micro matte in cell interiors
sets.surface: Mirror bright ridges, bead blasted inner walls, micro chamfers on apertures to catch light
sets.stones: Calibre emerald hexes and kites set as windows within cells, diamond micro lines along spine ribs
sets.silhouette: A wide collar that sits slightly high with graded lattice density, airy drop earrings from mini domes, a cuff bracelet that wraps with an open underside, a vaulted dome ring with anchored base, and a pendant that miniaturizes the dome
sets.motif: Parametric mashrabiya cell field woven from ogee curves and split leaves
sets.rhythm: Radial density near center that fades to open cells toward the edges, symmetric left to right but gradually lighter outward
sets.structure: Three dimensional lattice engineered with variable rib thickness to balance stiffness and weight, hidden tension cable across the collar back, stones held in recessed channels with micro bars, anti rotation tabs on the ring
avoid: Religious symbols or sacred inscriptions
Literal building silhouettes
Overly thin ribs that deform under wear
Star motifs that read as national or sectarian emblems
Thick solid plates that kill the airy intent
Clunky hinges that interrupt the lattice
design_dna: Every lattice intersection thickens subtly to read as a structural node.
Apertures that receive emeralds are always framed by a bright polished chamfer.
The cell scale reduces by one third as it moves toward the center of a focal element.
Diamonds draw a single spine line that guides the eye through each silhouette.
Edges finish in a smooth continuous rim so fabric cannot snag.
Earrings and pendants use open backs to let light pass through green windows.
Cuffs and collars include contoured inner pads for pressure distribution.
Ring under galleries mirror the outer cell geometry to complete the architecture.

concept_art.form: Vaulted lattice of ogee cells forming a light dome
concept_art.motion: Air flowing through cells while the frame holds steady
concept_art.material: Platinum ribs polished like glass and matte inner walls with emerald windows
concept_art.atmosphere: Architectural clarity, airy grandeur, future classic
